title: AdaptAV: Continuous Adaption of Vision Models for Autonomous Vehicles Using Cloud-based Oracle
abstract: arXiv:2608.28673v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deploying vision perception models in autonomous vehicles requires that we prioritize inference speeds, resulting in a model with shallower architectures and lesser model parameters (i.e., more pruned). Such small models do not generalize well, which could result in poor performance when encountered with novel scenarios. We propose a system that overcomes this by continuously retraining the vision models on the cloud with data uploaded by vehicles. We leverage the abundant compute resources, including machine learning accelerators, of the cloud to run a highly-accurate oracle model that will guide the retraining process of the on-vehicle model. This newly trained model is transmitted to the vehicle over the network and is utilized by the vehicle for perceptions, leading to improved inference accuracy over time.

translated_title: AdaptAV：基于云端Oracle的自动驾驶汽车视觉模型持续自适应
translated_abstract: 在自动驾驶汽车中部署视觉感知模型需要优先考虑推理速度，这导致模型采用更浅的架构和更少的模型参数（即经过更多剪枝）。这类小型模型的泛化能力不佳，在遇到新场景时可能导致性能下降。我们提出了一个系统来克服这一问题，该系统利用车辆上传的数据在云端持续重新训练视觉模型。我们借助云端丰富的计算资源（包括机器学习加速器）来运行一个高精度的oracle模型，由它来指导车载模型的重新训练过程。新训练好的模型通过网络传输回车辆，供其用于感知任务，从而使推理精度随时间不断提升。
tldr: 该论文提出AdaptAV系统，利用云端高精度oracle模型指导基于车辆上传数据的持续重训练，解决了车载轻量化视觉模型泛化能力差的问题，使其推理精度随时间不断提升。
en_tdlr: AdaptAV is a system that continuously retrains lightweight on-vehicle vision models in the cloud, using a highly-accurate cloud-based oracle to guide retraining with vehicle-uploaded data, thereby improving inference accuracy over time for autonomous vehicles.
